visualLocks.silhouette: Tall lean adult human; two arms/two legs; silver center-parted medium hair and mature stubbled face.
visualLocks.costume: Dark burgundy worn leather long coat and its source seams/lacing/rolled sleeves; blue-grey henley, black leather trousers, dark strapped boots, fingerless gloves and grey wrist wraps. Boot construction checked in enlarged official render: multiple broad overlapping diagonal/crossing shaft straps, side buckles and a separate ankle strap. Two isolated broad belts with plain leather between is an incorrect simplification.
visualLocks.equipment: Ivory silver in anatomical right, Ebony dark in anatomical left. Long customized notched slides, wood grips and portrait medallions. Rebellion hilt visible over right shoulder; full blade not proven by this body render.
visualLocks.exclusions: No DMC1/3/4 costume, 2013 reboot, Nero DevilBreaker, Vergil blue coat/Yamato, anime face or generic tactical armor.

universeCoherence.settings: Red Grave City stone/brick streets and ruins, Devil May Cry agency-inspired interiors, Qliphoth-inspired supernatural roots. New compositions are original scenes, not asserted exact canonical sites.
universeCoherence.excludedSharedDossierSetting: Mallet Island belongs to a different episode and is not used as the blanket setting of this DMC5 series.

knownExistingSpriteDiscrepancies: Current generated sprite adds a red buttoned chest/shoulder armor that the downloaded DMC5 render does not show; retain that old sprite as a variant, never treat it as sole canonical reference.
limits: Body and weapon files are real official artwork mirrored by third-party Wiki, not direct Capcom downloads.
Face Steam asset is a genuine game community item; exact 3D facial microgeometry cannot be certified from stylized pixel art.
Rebellion full blade has not been retrieved independently; CG02 uses the fully viewed Ebony/Ivory pair instead.
New poses and scenes are original interpretations; no blanket perfect1:1 certification.

sourceInterpretationCorrections.detail: An earlier producer/reviewer instruction of two boot straps alone was incorrect. Enlarging the actual promotional source proved intermediate diagonal bands are canonical; all affected unregistered CG were sent for ImageGen correction before integration.
